accepted_rows.title: Brewminaries Homebrew Club Meeting
accepted_rows.description:
The Brewminaries is a homebrew club in Brooklyn focused on helping every member make better beer through experiments, collaborative brewing, and monthly meetings. We were founded in 2015, when brewers who regularly attended the local homebrew shop Bitter and Esters’ bottle swaps wanted to make better beer. Over the past five years the club has rapidly grown into the largest homebrew club in New York City. We are now 170 members strong.
The Brewminaries is a club focused on accelerating our members to advanced brewing levels and beyond. We give members the tools, knowledge, and the combined learning experiences of the entire club. We also pride ourselves on being a positive and inclusive club that provides educational opportunities for all of our members. A group that includes everyone, from amateurs to professionals, our commitment to collaboration and experimentation drives the club towards better beer.
More information about the club and how to become a member at
www.brewminaries.com

accepted_rows.title: Quartz Casino Band
accepted_rows.description:
Country music in New York might die like a sidewalk crack bloom on a well trodden path. Formed by Andrew Spaulding (Pill) and Oscar Allen Guinn (Rhinestone) Quartz Casino Band thrives in the Brooklyn soil: watered by whiskey, fertilized by lead paint flakes, and the J train’s lullaby.  Where the train goes the track goes first; respect to those who sang before is the key to country. QCB touches on the music of Steve Earle, Eagles, Lee Hazlewood, and, of course, George Jones.  The diversity of songwriting is apparent, no one song sounds the same as the last, but they’re all complimentary like a good plate of country cooking should be.  Share a beer and a tear, have a party if it’s hearty, Quartz Casino Band will be there for both.

For them, there was only one choice for playing music: the parks.
The band’s true origin story is a tale of shelping gear to Washington Square Park, where they began busking just for the pure joy of it. Those early sessions were beautiful—a raw, immediate connection with crowds who were just as eager to gather, listen, and feel alive again. That energy is woven into the DNA of The Third Rails. It's why our sound is often described as a “giant melting pot,” that perfectly mirrors the complexity and excitement of the city we love and represent.
Dave and Andre's music is deeply rooted in this experience. Our originals, which we sometimes perform at local venues, shed light on the many faults and issues of the New York City Metropolitan Transit Authority and the persistent realities of living in a big city.

Learn to pair sake and cheese — fun, interactive, and absolutely delicious.
Step away from that bottle of vino and join us to sample the absolute best beverage to pair with cheese — we are talking about sake! If you haven't yet tried pairing craft sake and premium cheese, you are in for a revelation.
We'll explore a wide range of flavors and textures, and together we'll discover the most exciting combinations of sake styles and cheeses from around the world. The experience is fun, interactive, and absolutely delicious. Join us at Brooklyn Kura to learn about sake where sake is made!

A welcome sake to get you started
A brief intro to sake and cheese basics
Guided tasting of 5 Japanese craft sakes from different regions, paired to perfection with 5 outstanding cheese varieties

What is the Twenty Sided Top 8?
By playing in any regular draft event with us, you earn points towards the

. If you go undefeated, you earn some more.

Team Draft

How to Play Draft at Twenty Sided
At the start of a draft, everyone at the table will open 1 of the 3
Booster Packs
and pick a card -
don't show the table what you pick!
Then when everyone is ready, you will simultaneously pass the rest of your pack to the player on your left.
You then pick a card from the pack you just received and then everyone passes again. This keeps going until all cards have been taken (at an 8 person table, you will only see the pack you opened one additional time).
Once the first pack has been successfully drafted, everyone will open their second pack and take a card just like the first pack - but this time, everyone passes their packs to their right.
After all those cards are drafted, do the same with the third pack, passing to the left again. You'll often hear, "left, right, left" as people remember and confirm the draft pack order!
After that, you build a deck from the cards you picked. We provide basic lands for borrow to add to your deck -
Don't forget to return our lands at the end of the event :)
Draft Set
We typically draft the most recent Magic set. Draft events are always 3 rounds long, best of three games, and each round is 50 minutes long. Each round you'll get paired up to play someone with roughly the same record as you.

Receive 3 packs
Each round open 1 pack at a time
Pick and pass cards, until all the cards in the pack have been selected.
First pack pass left, second pack right, third pack left again.
Build a minimum 40 card deck
Decks usually have around 23 non-land cards and 17 lands, aiming for about 15 creatures in your deck
Play best of three games each round.
Play in all three rounds, each round timed at 50 minutes

Promo pack awarded randomly per table

Magic: the Gathering Draft Format
Draft is a
Limited Format
event where you open one
Booster Pack
at a time and pick and pass cards to build a deck out of the cards you selected.
Each player will receive 3
Booster Packs
. Players will get paired up to play in a 3 round, swiss-style, casual tournament.
What is the Twenty Sided Top 8?
By playing in any regular draft event with us, you earn points towards the
Twenty Sided Top 8 Invitational
. If you go undefeated, you earn some more.
Points escalate weekly
so it's never to late to join!

Team Draft
. Winning teammates of that draft receive an exclusive playmat!

Twenty Sided™ Top 8
is a perfect mix of casual play and light competitive fun.

At the start of a draft, everyone at the table will open 1 of the 3
Booster Packs
and pick a card -
don't show the table what you pick!
Then when everyone is ready, you will simultaneously pass the rest of your pack to the player on your left.
You then pick a card from the pack you just received and then everyone passes again. This keeps going until all cards have been taken (at an 8 person table, you will only see the pack you opened one additional time).
Once the first pack has been successfully drafted, everyone will open their second pack and take a card just like the first pack - but this time, everyone passes their packs to their right.

Receive 3 packs
Each round open 1 pack at a time
Pick and pass cards, until all the cards in the pack have been selected.
First pack pass left, second pack right, third pack left again.
Build a minimum 40 card deck

Play best of three games each round.
Play in all three rounds, each round timed at 50 minutes

1-2 or 0-3: 1 pack
Promo pack awarded randomly per table

Affinity
for Cats
.
